title: Portuguese Street Market Vila Nova de Cerveira by nomadas
author: nomadas
sourceDescription: Big Saturday street market in Portuguese village Vila Nova de Cerveira, next to the Spanish border. This was recorded while roaming through its crowded textile section. Some sellers shout out their deals and talk to their customers.
